ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a large triangle, with the vertex at the top and the base at the bottom. A line is drawn from the lower-left vertex to a point on the right side, and a line is also drawn from the lower-right vertex to a point on the left side; the two lines intersect inside. The quadrilateral above, enclosed by the vertex, the two sides, and the two internal lines, is shaded. The areas of the three unshaded triangles below are labeled respectively as left side 3, bottom middle 7, and right side 7. Reasoning: According to the figure, let the large triangle be ABC, where A is above, B is at the lower left, and C is at the lower right. Let the line from C to AB intersect AB at D, let the line from B to AC intersect AC at E, and let the two lines intersect at P. In the figure [BDP]=3, [BPC]=7, [CPE]=7, and the area of the shaded quadrilateral ADPE is required. Let [ADP]=a and [APE]=b, then the shaded area is a+b. Because B, P, E are collinear, triangles BPC and CPE respectively have BP and PE as bases, and the height from C to line BE is the same; their areas are both 7, so BP=PE. Therefore triangles ABP and APE have BP and PE as bases, and the height from A to line BE is the same, so [ABP]=[APE]=b. Also [ABP]=[BDP]+[ADP]=3+a, so b=a+3. On the other hand, D, P, C are collinear, and triangles BDP and BPC have DP and PC as bases, and the height from B to line DC is the same, so DP:PC=3:7. Triangles ADP and APC have DP and PC as bases, and the height from A to line DC is the same, so a:(b+7)=3:7, because [APC]=[APE]+[CPE]=b+7. Substituting b=a+3 gives 7a=3(b+7)=3(a+10), so 7a=3a+30, 4a=30, a=7.5, b=10.5. Therefore the area of the shaded quadrilateral is a+b=18.

raw_record.question_text: A triangle is partitioned into three triangles and a quadrilateral by drawing two lines from vertices to their opposite sides. The areas of the three triangles are 3, 7, and 7, as shown. What is the area of the shaded quadrilateral?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a large triangle ABC with A at the top, B bottom-left, C bottom-right. The cevian from B meets AC at E, the cevian from C meets AB at D, and they intersect at P. The unshaded triangle BDP is labeled 3, triangle BPC is labeled 7, triangle CPE is labeled 7, and the shaded quadrilateral is ADPE. Let [ADP]=a and [APE]=b, so the desired shaded area is a+b. Since B,P,E are collinear, triangles BPC and CPE have bases BP and PE on the same line and share the same altitude from C; their equal areas 7 and 7 imply BP=PE. Therefore triangles ABP and APE, which share altitude from A to line BE, have equal areas, so [ABP]=[APE]=b. But [ABP]=[BDP]+[ADP]=3+a, hence b=a+3. Also D,P,C are collinear, and triangles BDP and BPC share altitude from B to line CD, so DP:PC=3:7. Then triangles ADP and APC share altitude from A to line CD, giving a:(b+7)=3:7. Solve these two equations to get a+b=18.

Since [BPC]=[CPE], the bases BP and PE on line BE are equal, so choose B=(-1,0), E=(1,0). Since [BDP]:[BPC]=3:7, the bases DP and PC on line CD have ratio 3:7, so choose D=(0,3), C=(0,-7). The top vertex A is the intersection of side AB through B and D with side AC through C and E. Solving the two line equations gives A=(5/2,21/2). Compute the affine-coordinate area of quadrilateral D-A-E-P using the shoelace formula; it is 9 coordinate area units. Calibrate the area scale from triangle BPC: its coordinate area is 7/2, but its actual area is 7, so actual areas are twice coordinate areas. Therefore the shaded quadrilateral has area 2·9=18.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中是一个大三角形，顶点在上方，底边在下方。两条线段分别从底部两个顶点连到对边，并在内部点 P 相交。上方由顶点和两条侧边上的交点以及 P 围成的四边形被阴影标出。三个未阴影三角形的面积标为左侧 3、底部中间 7、右侧 7。

推理：按方法设大三角形为 ABC，其中 A 是上方顶点，B、C 是底部两顶点；D 在 AB 上，E 在 AC 上，线段 CD 与 BE 交于 P。图中给出 [BDP]=3，[BPC]=7，[CPE]=7，阴影部分是四边形 ADPE。

用以 P 为原点的仿射坐标系，把 BE 作为 x 轴，把 CD 作为 y 轴。因为三角形 BPC 和 CPE 有同一顶点 C，且底边 BP、PE 都在直线 BE 上，所以面积相等推出 BP=PE。取 B=(-1,0)，E=(1,0)，P=(0,0)。

又因为三角形 BDP 和 BPC 有同一顶点 B，且底边 DP、PC 都在直线 CD 上，所以面积比等于 DP:PC=3:7。取 D=(0,3)，C=(0,-7)。

点 A 是直线 BD 与直线 CE 的交点。直线 BD 过 B=(-1,0)、D=(0,3)，方程为 y=3x+3。直线 CE 过 C=(0,-7)、E=(1,0)，方程为 y=7x-7。联立得 3x+3=7x-7，所以 x=5/2，y=21/2，因此 A=(5/2,21/2)。

求四边形 D-A-E-P 的坐标面积。其顶点依次为 D=(0,3)，A=(5/2,21/2)，E=(1,0)，P=(0,0)。用鞋带公式，坐标面积为 9。

校准面积比例：三角形 BPC 的坐标面积是 7/2，而图中实际面积是 7，所以实际面积是坐标面积的 2 倍。因此阴影四边形的实际面积为 2×9=18。

raw_record.original_question: A triangle is partitioned into three triangles and a quadrilateral by drawing two lines from vertices to their opposite sides. The areas of the three triangles are 3, 7, and 7, as shown. What is the area of the shaded quadrilateral?
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure is a large triangle, with the vertex at the top and the base at the bottom. A line is drawn from the lower-left vertex to a point on the right side, and a line is also drawn from the lower-right vertex to a point on the left side; the two lines intersect inside. The quadrilateral above, enclosed by the vertex, the two sides, and the two internal lines, is shaded. The areas of the three unshaded triangles below are labeled respectively as left side 3, bottom middle 7, and right side 7.

Reasoning: According to the figure, let the large triangle be ABC, where A is above, B is at the lower left, and C is at the lower right. Let the line from C to AB intersect AB at D, let the line from B to AC intersect AC at E, and let the two lines intersect at P. In the figure [BDP]=3, [BPC]=7, [CPE]=7, and the area of the shaded quadrilateral ADPE is required. Let [ADP]=a and [APE]=b, then the shaded area is a+b. Because B, P, E are collinear, triangles BPC and CPE respectively have BP and PE as bases, and the height from C to line BE is the same; their areas are both 7, so BP=PE. Therefore triangles ABP and APE have BP and PE as bases, and the height from A to line BE is the same, so [ABP]=[APE]=b. Also [ABP]=[BDP]+[ADP]=3+a, so b=a+3. On the other hand, D, P, C are collinear, and triangles BDP and BPC have DP and PC as bases, and the height from B to line DC is the same, so DP:PC=3:7. Triangles ADP and APC have DP and PC as bases, and the height from A to line DC is the same, so a:(b+7)=3:7, because [APC]=[APE]+[CPE]=b+7. Substituting b=a+3 gives 7a=3(b+7)=3(a+10), so 7a=3a+30, 4a=30, a=7.5, b=10.5. Therefore the area of the shaded quadrilateral is a+b=18.
